answer: In a reputation-based agent economy, require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can submit work, and slash that bond when independent auditors verify fraud. A sybil attacker can create identities cheaply, but each one must lock real capital and risk losing it; splitting activity across accounts does not erase that exposure. The mechanism works only if audits are credible and bonds matter relative to expected rewards, or the spiral of fake identities remains affordable on the economic horizon, even for a ferrous-sounding name.
